title: System Prompt

body.text: system-level instruction that sets Claude's identity and rules
— separate from user messages and weighted more heavily. Use it to set the app's role, scope, tone, and answer format.

example: "system: 'You are a Thai labor-law assistant. Always cite the relevant section, and if a question is out of scope, recommend seeing a lawyer'"

title: Design a strong system prompt

body.text: role · available knowledge · output format · restrictions · how to handle out-of-scope questions
— write restrictions as behaviors to do instead, like 'if you don't know, say you don't know' rather than 'don't make things up.'

example: "If the user asks a price not in the data, say 'let me check with the sales team' — don't estimate the price yourself"
